text:
Type: solid wood dining bench
Use: seating at a dining table, a spot to sit in a hallway; dining room, kitchen, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, rustic
Materials: solid birch with a whitewashed matte lacquer, visible pegged joints
Colors: pale whitewashed birch, light warm wood
Shape: long flat seat with rounded corners, four splayed square legs, low center stretcher, visible dowel joints, light and simple, slim
Feel: airy, natural, calm, crafted
Goes with: light wood tables, white walls, linen, black or green accents; Scandinavian, Japandi or farmhouse dining rooms

product.name: NORRKER
product.description: Durable and hard-wearing; meets the requirements on furniture for public use.
